Other sub‐categories reflected in the literature included ‘Structural interventions’ ( n = 1) (Carew et al., 2019 ), ‘Anti‐bullying policies and programmes’ ( n = 1) (Devries et al., 2018 ), ‘Educational services development’ ( n = 6) (Carew et al., 2019 ; Pawar & Mohite, 2014 ), and ‘Rehabilitation and health services, and assistive technologies’ (Lal, 2010 ). No studies represented the intervention categories of ‘Accessibility of built environment and learning materials’ or ‘Inclusive education policies’.
